_basis: AQS-PLAN-011 section 5.3 and Table 5.2; functions from AGENTS.md (Redundancy: power, O2, water, CO2 removal, thermal, food, sanitation) | 2026-10-25 (X-LOC-11): ground_contact removed from the building class - bearing and earthing are structural matters (foundations on land, the hull deck per class rules at sea), not an environmental service the site profile provides. | 2026-10-26 (X-LOC-09): locale-replacement classes radiator, press_tank, recovery_header, catalytic and resistance_heater carry no site capability (closed or line-powered hardware); ZNBR2_BR2_REGEN moves from the scrubber-class blanket to a by-unit entry (closed electrolytic bromine-regen loop, no atmospheric discharge; FLOW_BATTERY.md) | 2026-10-26 (X-LOC-10): microgravity-replacement classes li_ion, wet_ox, hydroponics and membrane carry no site capability (sealed, pressure-bound or capillary hardware) | 2026-10-26 (X-LOC-09 remainder): the intake class is a resource boundary (GW_INTAKE, ATM_INT) with no site capability; the ice_extract class needs ground contact by design

needs.buoyant_separation: a minimum apparent gravity, steady in direction, to separate gas from liquid or solids from liquid
needs.free_surface: a liquid surface open to a gas space
needs.air_heat_sink: outside air at a usable temperature
needs.vent_sink: an atmosphere that can take a vent or relief discharge
needs.ground_contact: soil or rock for bearing, earthing or heat exchange
needs.liquid_water_at_ambient: external pressure above the triple point of water
